Class ClientStateListenerCli

java.lang.Object
network.client.core.cli.ClientStateListenerCli
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClientStateListener
public class ClientStateListenerCli extends Object implements ClientStateListener
CLI implementation of ClientStateListener. Renders inbound server events to System.out through a GameStateRenderer, on the network reader thread. The onXxx callbacks are synchronized so renders never interleave with each other.
